Here is what you're looking for Previous All General Design Performance Health AI What's the Best Next What are the key features of Galaxy Watch9? Galaxy Watch9 comes with a larger battery and upgraded processor for everyday health monitoring. Compared to the Galaxy Watch8 40 mm model, Galaxy Watch9 40 mm model has a 20 % larger battery. Galaxy Watch9 is the first Galaxy Watch with Snapdragon® Wear Elite Platform. , , What colours do Galaxy Watch9 come in? Galaxy Watch9 is available in different colours, based on the size option. 40 mm model: Available in Cream and Graphite. 44 mm model: Available in Silver and Graphite. What size options do Galaxy Watch9 come in? Galaxy Watch9 is available in two sizes — 40 mm and 44 mm. How much larger is the Galaxy Watch9 battery compared to Galaxy Watch8? The 40 mm model has a 390 mAh battery, and the 44 mm model has a 445 mAh battery. The higher capacity allows Galaxy Watch9 to require less frequent charging. This means you can keep the Watch powered throughout the day with minimal downtime thanks to their longer-lasting battery. , What processor does Galaxy Watch9 use? Galaxy Watch9 uses the Snapdragon® Wear Elite Platform. This advanced processor delivers: Smooth, seamless performance. Less lag or load. Quick app launches, fluid and responsive interactions. Does Galaxy Watch9 have a clear display? Galaxy Watch9 features a sapphire crystal display that delivers a brightness level of up to 3,000 nits, ensuring clear visibility even in bright sunlight. The high‑resolution screen provides crisp visuals for notifications, apps and health data. How does Galaxy Watch9 calculate my Fitness Index? Galaxy Watch9 calculates your Fitness Index by analyzing your body composition and workout history. Get a personalized fitness score that reflects your current physical performance and health data. Discover workout content tailored to your fitness level and training goals. How does Galaxy Watch9 track my Daily Cardio Load? Galaxy Watch9 measures the physical strain you accumulate throughout the day. Daily Cardio Load tracks your daily physical load by monitoring your activity levels — using sensors on Galaxy Watch9 to record exercise intensity and duration. Based on this data, the feature estimates the recovery time your body needs. This helps you know when to push harder and when to take it easy. How does Vitals work on Galaxy Watch9? Galaxy Watch9 analyses key biometric signals — heart rate, heart rate variability, respiration rate, skin temperature and blood oxygen level — to detect early signals of change in your body. This allows you to take action early, with guidance designed to help you stay healthy. What affects my Heart Health Score on Galaxy Watch9? Your Heart Health Score is based on three daily factors: how long you sleep, your body mass index (BMI), and the amount of vigorous activity you get. Together, these reflect how your lifestyle may impact cardiovascular health. When your score is low, Galaxy Watch9 provides personalised guidance to help you improve. This makes it easier to take practical steps to support heart health. The focus is on prevention and healthy habits, not medical diagnosis. How do I use Raise to Talk on my Galaxy Watch9? To use Raise to Talk (RTT) on Galaxy Watch9, simply raise your wrist to start an AI conversation. This action triggers built-in Google Gemini to respond immediately. You can get instant answers without needing to touch the Watch. The feature is designed to prioritise fast, on-the-go assistance. Response speed is optimised for immediate, convenient support. Details about phone proximity requirements are not specified. , Does Galaxy Watch9 support both LTE and Bluetooth? Yes, Galaxy Watch9 supports both LTE and Bluetooth. It features Bluetooth 6.0 for easy pairing with your phone and LTE for independent cellular connectivity. This means you can stay connected and make calls even when your phone isn’t nearby. LTE availability depends on your country/region and carrier. Will Galaxy Watch9's larger battery reduce the need for frequent charging during travel? Yes, the larger battery reduces the need for frequent charging. The increased capacity means fewer charges are needed. You can use Galaxy Watch9 while you're on a trip, with less concern about finding a power source.
